description: This dataset provides the exposure layers used in a river flood risk assessment for İzmir, Türkiye, within the CLIMAA project. It was published on Zenodo on 26 February 2026 by Çağlar Tükel, Akın Küçükyılmaz, Seray Şengül and Cagri Hasan Karaman, with İzmir Metropolitan Municipality listed as a creator. It contains building footprints (Buildings.gpkg) used for structural exposure and building-level impacts, a gridded total population raster used for exposed and displaced population, and critical infrastructure points of interest, including separate GeoJSON layers of kindergartens, primary, secondary and high schools, universities and a combined schools layer. Coverage is the İzmir study area. Access: three files on Zenodo (buildings about 147 MB, critical infrastructure about 2 MB, population raster about 4 MB). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: only the education layers were read in the description; other facility types, sources and dates of the footprints are not stated in what was read. Simulation uses: flood exposure of buildings, population and schools for risk and evacuation planning. Related records: the Türkiye 2023 earthquake building damage data.
